label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameterValues() flows directly into SQL query via HashMap round-trip (param -> map29572.put/get -> bar) and is concatenated into SQL string without parameterization. Although ESAPI encoder is called, it encodes the entire SQL string including the injection point, so SQL injection still occurs. The XSS alert is triggered on the concatenation site which is a real vulnerability.

evidence.note: user param flows through HashMap roundtrip into SQL query without proper sanitization
